The 30-storey tower is developed by Al Sondos Holding and the construction was completed in 2007. outside view of Marina Mansions Marina Mansions is a 30-storey residential tower in Dubai Marina [...] Dubai Marina, The Mansions has a basement floor, a ground level, a mezzanine floor and 29 residential floors. The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments, duplexes and penthouses to interested buyers and tenants besides retail options. You can spot the high-rise within walking distance of the Dubai Marina Mall, DMCC Metro Station and JBR. Residents can make use of the luxurious amenities and facilities the parent neighbourhood has to offer, including cafes, bars, grocery stores and restaurants. Blossom Marina Nursery is a 3-minute drive from Marina Mansions. ### In a Nutshell [...] #### 4-Bedroom Apartments in Marina Mansions 4-bedroom apartments in Marina Mansion Tower have covered areas starting from 4,721 sq. ft. There are four bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and ensuite bathrooms. Marble-floored and the granite-finished kitchen are spacious and elegant. These apartments also have a guest bathroom and a separate maid’s room. Each unit gets at least two parking spaces in the dedicated area. #### Penthouses in Marina Mansions 4-bed penthouses in Marina Mansion Tower are luxurious units featuring four bedrooms, a maid’s room, an elegant kitchen, a private Jacuzzi and six bathrooms. The covered areas for these units exceed 6,000 sq. ft. The huge terrace offers stunning views of the Dubai Marina and the skyline.
